text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, I saw Believe briskly
weaving her way through the students.
choice_data_list: Believe, what's got you in such a hurry?
Believe, why are you in such a hurry?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I need to redo
the work I took on yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The wall I repaired today...
I had a bit of trouble around the edges...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(............Ah! If I had smoothed it out from the opposite direction,
wouldn't it have looked much cleaner...?)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Right...
And then I do this to that part...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I spent all of last night worrying about a mistake at work... *yaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm in a rush.
Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Believe wasn't able to rest well last night.
